# montecarlo_informatica_v2_credentials (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `auth_mode` (String) How Monte Carlo signs in. `password` takes `username` and `password`. `oauth` takes `org_id` and the `oauth_*` fields.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `base_url` (String) Informatica login URL for your POD. Leave it out for https://dm-us.informaticacloud.com.
- `oauth_access_token_endpoint` (String) Identity provider URL Monte Carlo requests tokens from.
- `oauth_client_id` (String) Client ID of the app registered with your identity provider, for `oauth`.
- `oauth_client_secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Secret of the identity provider app, for `oauth`. Stored by Monte Carlo and never returned.
- `oauth_client_secret_wo_version` (Number) Bump to send `oauth_client_secret_wo` again. Terraform stores this, never the secret.
- `oauth_grant_type` (String) Grant Monte Carlo requests the token with, for `oauth`. `password` also takes `oauth_username` and `oauth_password`.
- `oauth_password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Password of `oauth_username`, for the `password` grant. Stored by Monte Carlo and never returned.
- `oauth_password_wo_version` (Number) Bump to send `oauth_password_wo` again. Terraform stores this, never the secret.
- `oauth_scope` (String) Scope to request the token with. Leave it out to request none.
- `oauth_username` (String) Identity provider user, for the `password` grant.
- `org_id` (String) Informatica organization ID, for `oauth`.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Password of `username`, for `password`. Stored by Monte Carlo and never returned.
- `password_wo_version` (Number) Bump to send `password_wo` again. Terraform stores this, never the secret.
- `username` (String) Informatica user, for `password`.

### Read-Only

- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
